author: Spartemex
body: I think we should have two different mix servers. One full gamemode mix, and a Nebula, or "Objectives" mix. I say this because, yes it's cool to have a full mix server, but I like playing CTW and CTF and DTM just on their own. I don't just want to play all DTM or all CTW. I think it would be cool if we had one mix that rotated through the nebula (objective) gamemodes, and another that rotated through them all.
